SELECT X.KEP_DEPT_NAME, X.KEP_USER_NAME, X.BUYER_NAME, DECODE(X.CLOSE_TYPE, 'AR', '매출', '물류비') AS CLOSE_TYPE, X.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE FROM (
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = A.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT MAX(USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.LEGACY_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, DECODE(A.KEP_DEPT, '114', (SELECT BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM FROM KEPMDCP02@KEPCON WHERE BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = A.BUYER_CODE), -- 114 건설, 118 유통 DECODE(A.KEP_DEPT, '118', (SELECT BIZNPLC_CLSS_NM FROM KEPMDCP03@KEPCON WHERE BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = A.BUYER_CODE), (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER_CODE))) AS BUYER_NAME, A.CLOSE_TYPE AS CLOSE_TYPE, TO_CHAR(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS CHANGE_DATE FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST A WHERE 1=1 AND A.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND A.CLOSE_TYPE = 'AR' AND A.CLOSE_CMPL_YN = 'N'
UNION
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = MNG.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE LUSR.USER_ID = MNG.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GR.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, 'AR' AS CLOSE_TYPE, NULL AS CHANGE_DATE FROM ICOMGRDT GR, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE 1=1 AND GR.BUYER = MNG.BUYER(+) AND MNG.STATUS(+) = 'C' AND MNG.PRIORITY(+) = 'Y' AND MNG.YEAR(+) = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{st_from_date},'YYYYMM'),'YYYY') AND GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} || '01' AND #{st_from_date} || '31' AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' AND GR.BUYER NOT IN('KRKORE0001','KRKEPB0004','KRTEST0035', 'KRTEST0033', 'KRHIUX0001') AND GR.BUYER NOT IN( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT4 = 'B' AND FLAG= 'Y') AND GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'N'
UNION
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = MNG.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, '박지수' AS KEP_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GR.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, 'LG' AS CLOSE_TYPE, NULL AS CHANGE_DATE FROM ICOMGRDT GR, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE 1=1 AND GR.BUYER = MNG.BUYER(+) AND MNG.STATUS(+) = 'C' AND MNG.PRIORITY(+) = 'Y' AND MNG.YEAR(+) = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{st_from_date},'YYYYMM'),'YYYY') AND GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} || '01' AND #{st_from_date} || '31' AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' AND GR.BUYER NOT IN('KRKORE0001','KRKEPB0004','KRTEST0035', 'KRTEST0033', 'KRHIUX0001') AND GR.BUYER NOT IN( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT4 = 'B' AND FLAG= 'Y') AND NVL(GR.LOGIS_BILL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND GR.PROCESS_TYPE IN('2','3') GROUP BY MNG.KEP_DEPT
UNION
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = AR.DEPT_CODE) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE LUSR.USER_ID = AR.ADD_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = AR.BUYER_CODE) AS BUYER_NAME, 'AR' AS CLOSE_TYPE, NULL AS CHANGE_DATE FROM KEPTARDT AR WHERE 1=1 AND AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND STATUS <> 'D' AND AR.AR_TYPE = '01' AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'N'
UNION
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = AR.DEPT_CODE) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, '박지수' AS KEP_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = AR.BUYER_CODE)) AS BUYER_NAME, 'LG' AS CLOSE_TYPE, NULL AS CHANGE_DATE FROM KEPTARDT AR WHERE 1=1 AND AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND STATUS <> 'D' AND AR.AR_TYPE = '02' AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY AR.DEPT_CODE
) X GROUP BY X.KEP_DEPT_NAME, X.KEP_USER_NAME, X.BUYER_NAME, X.CLOSE_TYPE, X.CHANGE_DATE ORDER BY X.CLOSE_TYPE, X.KEP_DEPT_NAME, X.KEP_USER_NAME
